review_evidence: Independently read pinned section 3.1 equations (4),(5), Lemma 3.4, and the whole Appendix B.3 proof of Lemma B.8, then compared the packet statement, anonymous reconstruction, full current Lean module, and English lesson. The recursive definition was checked through its displayed expanded single-block formula and concrete coordinate adapter. The lesson matches each construction step, including r=0. The only change of domain is the disclosed total algebraic definition; it does not broaden the spectral or minimizer claims. This is a scoped independent semantic review of the supplied candidate only. Compilation and axiom reports were supplied as background and are not used as semantic equivalence evidence; no aggregate-gate outcome is asserted.

assumptions.evidence: A polynomial block expression and the finite quotient/remainder adapter remain definable without these inequalities. The candidate explicitly distinguishes the total algebraic definition from its source-range properties.

conclusion.evidence: Nat.div_add_mod supplies q*n+r=d. The adapter is (i,j)->j*n+i and tail t->q*n+t; thus both formula and ordering agree. When r=0 the Fin0 identity has no entries, matching the source omission of residual coordinates. The lesson accurately describes assembly and this empty-tail case.

domains.evidence: The candidate assumptions disclose the total algebraic extension. On the source domain it is exactly (5). For n=0, natural division gives quotient 0 and remainder d, so this extension is I_d; this extra-domain definition makes no spectral assertion.

objects.evidence: Pinned section 3.1 equations (4),(5); the packet expands singleBlockPrecision to exactly equation (4). prodComm followed by finProdFinEquiv flattens (i,j) as j*n+i; sum flattening places tail t at (d/n)*n+t. Reindex uses the inverse of this same equivalence on both matrix indices. Thus the matrix is the literal consecutive-block precision, not an arbitrary permutation or abstract surrogate.
